frequency_question: How often do central banks activate or raise the countercyclical capital buffer above zero within a 28-month observation window when baseline capital settings are at zero?
membership_rule: Includes any G20 banking system operating under Basel III capital rules where the countercyclical capital buffer rate was initiated at 0% and a policy change was deliberated and enacted or left unchanged within a defined 28-month horizon.

cases.name: Canada OSFI domestic stability buffer introduction

coverage_note: 6 named windows; captures both US historical inaction and peer activations under similar structural frameworks.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions to maintain comparability with Federal Reserve regulatory complexity.
skeleton: Major jurisdictions subject to Basel III framework with 0% initial CCyB over rolling 28-month windows, categorized by systematic activation vs inertia.
multiplier: 2 active activation clusters out of 6 major observed historical windows in peer jurisdictions / Fed evaluation windows.
validity_reason: Basel III implementation timelines and macroprudential regulatory architectures remain stable through this horizon.
